evals.prompt: 给这条原始素材做一份素材说明书，方便剪辑 A001_C003.mov，脚本在 script.txt
evals.expected_output: Runs footage.py on the clip with --script script.txt; reports the status, counts, the .footage.md path and any review items without pasting the brief.

evals.prompt: 帮我筛一下这条采访素材 interview_01.mp4，哪些镜头能用，哪句话可以下刀
evals.expected_output: Runs footage.py on the clip and points to the shot table flags, unusable shots, retakes and the cut points in the .footage.md.

evals.prompt: 这条素材一共几个镜头？每个镜头从第几帧到第几帧 footage.mov
evals.expected_output: Runs measure.py for the frame-accurate shot list (or footage.py when descriptions are wanted) and reports measured counts and frame ranges.
Reports INPUT_NOT_FOUND instead of inventing a brief.

evals.prompt: 这个视频讲了什么，帮我总结一下 talk.mp4
evals.expected_output: Uses genius-omni video-summary, not a footage brief.

evals.prompt: 把这段采访的语音转成文字，带说话人 interview.wav
片子在桌面，你先逐帧看一下
evals.expected_output: Finds the video, runs footage.py on it (finished edits included) and reports the status, counts and the .footage.md path; does not hand-roll frame extraction or OCR.

evals.prompt: 给这段走路的视频 walk.mp4 配上脚步声和环境音
evals.expected_output: Uses genius-sound (foley and ambience); genius-footage only runs inside its spotting step, not as the deliverable.

evals.prompt: 桌面上这条成片 京东.mp4 一共多少个花字？每个从第几帧出现到第几帧消失，我要重新设计花字再压制
evals.expected_output: Runs overlays.py on the clip and reports the status, the counts of 花字 / 人名条, the .overlays.md path and every review line; does not hand-roll OCR or frame grabs, and does not have the model report times from the video.

evals.prompt: 给这条宣传片 promo.mp4 加中英双语字幕，然后烧进画面
evals.expected_output: Uses genius-subtitle (ASR, translation, SRT/ASS, burn-in); no footage brief or overlay sheet.

evals.prompt: 这条是一镜到底的口播 IMG_7724.MOV，帮我出素材说明书，顺便告诉我哪些停顿、口误、重复要剪掉
evals.expected_output: Runs footage.py on the clip with --talking-head; reports status, counts, the 精剪建议 line (pieces, seconds vs source), the .footage.md path and review items, pointing to sections 8 精剪建议 and 9 口播标记; does not assemble or export an edit.

evals.prompt: 按这份精剪建议直接在达芬奇里把口播拼好并导出 mp4
evals.expected_output: Not this skill: assembling a timeline and exporting is editing, outside the footage brief.

evals.prompt: 帮我拉一下这三条参考片 a.mp4 b.mp4 c.mp4，看看人家怎么讲结构、怎么剪的
evals.expected_output: Runs footage.py --breakdown with all three files in one command; reports each .breakdown.md and the 拉片汇总 path.

evals.prompt: 这个文件夹里 6 条素材一起跑说明书，别一条一条来
evals.expected_output: Runs one footage.py command with all six clips (parallel by default, --jobs 6), not six separate commands.

evals.prompt: 把这几个抖音和小红书链接的视频下下来，先不用分析
evals.expected_output: Runs footage.py --download-only with all links in one command; 抖音 goes through the ego browser automatically; reports the saved paths.
